meanings.callbackWall: Performance.now() elapsed from entry to exit of production main.js frame. Includes JS, main-thread stalls and synchronous WebGL call wall time.
meanings.renderSubmit: Wall time inside unmodified look.render(scene, dt). May include synchronous driver work or waiting; is not GPU duration.
meanings.outsideCallback: Actual next callback-entry time minus prior callback-exit; includes all browser/compositor scheduling, other callbacks/tasks, idle and presentation cadence; cannot identify present wait specifically.
meanings.clockAlignment: A sampled producing frame is paired with the next production RAF. The passive observer ending at that next RAF is independently matched by timestamp.
meanings.deviceTelemetry: 0.5 s device and operating system samples apply to segment-level conditions; they are not per-frame GPU timing.
